text:
ANNOTATE BURST L2-ann-plateA — walkable floor, blocked areas, occluders, exits and spawn for a painted game room plate (Run C-3 lap 2, X6-class annotation for the Godot scene kit, SPEC § 7 lap 2 T3h schema). task_id "L2-ann-plateA".

Image 1 is a 1536×1024 painted scene plate of an open-air observatory terrace seen from a low elevated three-quarter camera: a compass-rose floor in the middle, a brass armillary on a round stepped plinth at the upper right, a stair at the upper left, a wooden desk and a chest at the left, an arched doorway on the right with steps, stone parapets and pillars along the front (bottom) edge, sky and mountains beyond the rear parapet. A standing character in this room is 171 px tall with her feet on the floor.
Write out/annotation.json in PLATE PIXEL coordinates (x right, y down; 0..1536 × 0..1024), polygons as ordered vertex lists (clockwise, not repeating the first vertex), following this schema exactly: {"plate_size":[1536,1024], "walkable":[<one or more polygons covering the floor where a character's FEET may stand — the paving inside the parapets, including the compass rose and the paved margins; exclude plinths, stairs, props, walls, sky>], "blocked":[<polygons of solid things standing ON or IN the walkable area that feet cannot enter: the armillary plinth base, the desk footprint, the chest footprint, pillar/statue bases, stair footprint if inside the floor, doorway step block>], "occluders":[{"id":"…","polygon":[…],"baseline_y":<the y of the object's ground contact line — a character whose feet are ABOVE (smaller y than) this line is BEHIND the object>}, … <every foreground object that should draw IN FRONT of a character walking behind it: each front parapet segment and pillar along the bottom edge, the desk, the chest, the plinth front, the doorway jambs; trace the visible silhouette of the object in the painting, generous by a few pixels>], "exits":[{"id":"doorway","segment":[[x,y],[x,y]]}, {"id":"stairs","segment":…}], "spawn":[x,y] <feet point in the open centre of the compass rose>, "figure_height_px":171, "notes":"one line"}. Be precise on the WALKABLE boundary: it follows the foot of the parapets/walls (the line where the floor meets them), not their tops. Also write out/annotation_overlay.png: Image 1 with walkable polygons filled translucent green, blocked translucent red, occluder outlines in yellow with their baseline as a dashed line, exits as cyan segments, spawn as a white cross — PIL drawing from your JSON is allowed ONLY for this overlay (no other code). No image_gen. No web. No files outside out/. calls_used 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "L2-ann-plateA"; images []; files [out/annotation.json, out/annotation_overlay.png + sha256]; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS; concerns for anything uncertain. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — the selected scene plate (A) to annotate
